preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 200000 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string S has a length between 1 and 200000.
Each string S contains only lowercase English letters.
The total length of all strings S across all test cases does not exceed 200000.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= len(S) for count, S in zip(output, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between 0 and the length of the corresponding string S.
